newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 18.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Sheikh Zaid meets U.S. defence secretary; calls for pressure on Israel to end Mideast impasse.
- Dubai Cable Co plans to invest about 110 million dirhams over the next two years to expand production of medium voltage cables and set up new factories.
- UAE president Sheikh Zaid and U.S. defence secretary discuss Middle East, Gulf issues. Sheikh Zaid urges U.S. pressure on Israel.
- al-Thuraya Space Communications Company set up with fully paid-up capital of 91.75 million dirhams.
- U.S. defence secretary Cohen says Iran successfully tested air-launched missiles.
- Emirates Industrial Bank approves loans worth 195 million dirhams.
